630240fd4794ee30c510ab1402e642ae0a674ce2.summary: Trend Micro's TrendLabs blog (published 2015-02-12) describes the Yanbian Gang, a Chinese cybercriminal group that uses Android malware to take money from South Korean bank account holders. The report says the group has been siphoning millions since 2013, transferring up to US$1,600 a day from victims' accounts. Its tools include fake banking apps impersonating five South Korean banks, apps that hijack banking sessions, fake popular apps, and fake Internet Police apps delivered through SMS phishing. The group recruits and coordinates over QQ Chat. The post says Trend Micro Mobile Security…

631b3385adedffab0810c6128364db0224b36b85.summary: The Record, July 2025, reports NSA and FBI officials saying Chinese Volt Typhoon efforts to pre-position on US critical infrastructure failed. Officials also describe an FBI takedown of a Flax Typhoon botnet, which the FBI official said was backed by the indicted Integrity Technology Group, and an arrest in Italy of a Chinese hacker allegedly involved in Silk Typhoon. The officials did not mention Salt Typhoon.
